text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: With my sword I shall carve the way! Unto glory—!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah... Rob Roy-san, that was amazing!
You looked just like the main character in a story...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaah?! Y-You heard that...?
That's so embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to be like a hero,
so I was imitating one from a novel.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I heard that even if it's just make-believe, actually
putting it into action is what's important...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Putting it into action is what's important...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(Rob Roy-san is so amazing...!
She's so cool...
...Rice wants to... Rice wants to, too—!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Even if we go around asking,
timing is also kind of an issue...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... Kita-san is in trouble...!
A-All right... First, take action...!
Rice can do it too... Rice can...!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Kita-san, Fenomeno-san,
is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we were exchanging opinions
about races, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
As we talked, we thought it'd be great
to hear what even more people think.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But everyone has their own training schedules,
so it's hard to just barge in on them...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oops! Fenomeno-san, you were on your way
to lunch, weren't you? Sorry for holding you up!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Helping children, citizens, and fellow horse girls alike
is the duty of this officer!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (Exchanging opinions... Lunch... In that case—)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-A Chat Lunch...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We could all eat together while we talk.
We can chat a lot about races,
and it would be super productive...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A Chat Lunch! Gathering people who are interested
in that day's theme...!
Wah! That's great, sounds super fun!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Let's give it a try, Kita-san, Fenomeno-san!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-Huuuueh?! The shop is goneeee!!

While walking near the station, I came across a group of horse girls.
It seems they were planning to have lunch together, but the restaurant they were aiming for was closed down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Rice-san, please do not be discouraged... desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Reporting in! I widened the search perimeter,
but every establishment is currently at full capacity!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I just wanted to make everyone happy,
but whenever Rice does something, misfortune always follows...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe it's really better if Rice doesn't
do anything at all...)
choice_data_list: Let's buy bento boxes and head to the park!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Bento boxes...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That sounds lovely, a park lunch.
How elegant and delightful desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eating outdoors really gets the conversation flowing!
A lunch in the park is so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Keeping watch over the town while dining with everyone.
This is killing two birds with one stone!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (Thank goodness... Everyone's enjoying themselves...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(...Still, Rice couldn't handle it on her own...
Maybe Rice really can't make everyone happy...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, everyone's time is being wasted
because of Rice...! What should we do...?!
choice_data_list: Let's run to a restaurant further away!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...True, around here is always crowded,
but if we go further out...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It will also serve as great exercise to build up an appetite.
All units, move out!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Here we can take our time and chat
without worrying about the clock!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Everything is guided by destiny!
To our encounter with this wonderful cafe—Salute!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(Is everyone just covering for me
out of pity...?)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... Rice really can't
make anyone happy after all...!)
